title: feat(nssums): nssame neighbor-lock sum: reverse fail, face fail
science: Sum letter on the nssame seed: L(A)=(4,0,0), L(B)=(0,0,1), L(C)=(0,1,0) (the mixed A-locks now sum to a defined vector instead of killing the letter), L(D)=(4,0,0) -> reverse FAIL, face FAIL.
